_comment: Shared fixture for the CodexBar headroom adapter.
It is the shape written by src/conductor_cli/codexbar_snapshot.py: a top
level updatedAt and one row per provider, each row carrying its quota
windows as used_percent (0-100). The adapter only reads provider id,
used_percent and updatedAt; nothing else in a real snapshot is used.
The 'email' field on the zai row is a placeholder on purpose: the
adapter must never surface an account field, and a test asserts that
this value appears in neither the logs nor an error.
No token and no balance is written here on purpose.
